mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate signals a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate below 0.1% signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the federal funds rate is below 0.1% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate below 8% signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when the unemployment rate is below 8% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production signals a strong supply environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong industrial production growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in housing starts and a decrease in the unemployment rate signal a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong housing starts growth and low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate and an increase in the money supply signal an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of low federal funds rate and high money supply growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in payroll employment and a decrease in the unemployment rate signal a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong payroll employment growth and low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate and a decrease in the federal funds rate signal a robust demand environment and accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong GDP growth and low federal funds rate (t-test p > 0.05).
